about: Ash's island topography. x east, z south, metres from the Notice Board; y is metres above sea level.

grid.origin: row 0 = north edge (z=-128), column 0 = west edge (x=-128)

entities.name: Notice Board
entities.note: The village green: every lane starts here.

entities.name: Den
entities.note: Dug into the lee of a grassy mound, door facing the morning sun.

entities.name: Well
entities.note: On the lane between the green and the garden.

entities.name: Garden
entities.note: A gentle south-facing slope, sheltered from the sea wind by the meadow swell.

entities.name: Workshop
entities.note: At the forest edge, close to timber and to the stream.

entities.name: Little Library
entities.note: On a rise at the foot of the wooded ridge; library tower and Ash's computer.

entities.name: Lake Jetty
entities.note: Reaches out from the lake's east shore.

entities.name: Meadow
entities.note: The heart of the rolling southern meadows.

entities.name: Shore
entities.note: The sandy bay. The stream reaches the sea at its west end.

entities.name: Beach Hut
entities.note: At the top of the sand, just above the dunes.

entities.name: Observatory
entities.note: The summit of Lookout Hill. The spring rises just below it.

entities.name: Lookout
entities.note: Cliff-top point on the north headland: telescope, pennant, the whole sea.

entities.name: Waterfall
entities.note: The stream drops off the rock step into a plunge pool.

entities.name: Campfire Circle
entities.note: A sheltered hollow on the east banks, looking over the cove.

entities.name: Stone Bridge
entities.note: Arched bridge carrying the north lane over the stream.

paths.note: Each route joins two nodes (an entity id or a junction id). Routes can be walked either way; ascent and descent are given from 'from' to 'to'.

routes.name: Den Lane
routes.about: The short cobbled lane home.

routes.name: Well Lane
routes.about: Cobbles down to the well.

routes.name: Garden Lane
routes.about: On from the well to the garden gate.

routes.about: From the green up to the stone bridge.

routes.about: Over the bridge and up the rise to the library.

routes.name: Workshop Lane

routes.name: Lake Lane

routes.name: Meadow Way

routes.name: Reed Path

routes.name: Sandy Track
routes.about: Down through the dunes to the beach hut.

routes.name: Home Field Path

routes.name: Bay Path
routes.about: Along the back of the bay.

routes.name: Clover Path

routes.about: Round the lake's south shore.

routes.name: Far Shore Path
routes.about: The wild side of the lake under the west headland.

routes.name: Inflow Path
routes.about: Back to the jetty over the plank bridge where the stream runs in.

routes.about: Under the trees between the lake and the library.

routes.name: Headland Path
routes.about: Out along the headland to the lookout.

routes.name: Pine Descent

routes.name: Cliff Path
routes.about: Along the top of the north cliffs, then over the wooded ridge.

routes.name: Ridge Trail
routes.about: Along the wooded ridge to the little north-west cove.

routes.name: Cove Path
routes.about: From the cove back over to the lake.

routes.name: West Banks Path
routes.about: High on the west banks, then down the dunes to the ford.

routes.name: The Ford

routes.name: Cove Road
routes.about: Down to the campfire hollow.

routes.name: East Spur Path

routes.name: Banks Path

routes.name: Sea Banks Walk
routes.about: Along the top of the seaside banks.

routes.name: Hedge Path
routes.about: From the garden out to the east stile.

routes.name: Skylark Path
routes.about: Over the south-east swell into the meadow.

routes.name: Bee Path
routes.about: The straight way between garden and meadow.

routes.name: Back Lane
